task: Fix Windows `codemie install pi` spawn ENOENT by passing shell on win32 in installRequiredPiPackages and skip redundant Pi package reinstall when Pi is already installed.

key_reasoning.reason: Confined to the Pi plugin (pi.packages.ts and PiPlugin.additionalInstallation); install.ts is shared with Claude and should stay untouched.

The shell: isWindows pattern already exists in processes.ts. Windows-only behavior has no tests, and CODEMIE_PI_BIN paths with spaces are unquoted under shell:true. Keeping the change local avoids the broad exec() consumer set.
